title: Specialist - Quality Engineering
description:
**Role description**

Role :Python Automation Lead API Automation E2E Functional Testing Understanding of AI Agent Creation and Implementation

Required Qualifications

SDET Total 5-8 years of experience in Selenium Python API Testing automation and Functional Testing

Helps design implement and maintain test automation frameworks for testing both UI and backend REST services

Creates maintains and executes automation scripts within a framework using Playwright with Python or Java with Rest Assured libraries

Establishing Automation Test Strategy Test Approach and Test plans

Works with development team in establishing test automation strategies

Contributes to supporting and reviewing other QA team members automation initiatives reviewing automation code of other team members and making sure industry level coding standards are followed Identify key barriers core problems and apply problem solving skills to address complex technical challenges

Testing across multiple levels Unit Integration System and end to end

Building automation tests using TDD BDD frameworks

Understanding of and experience implementing and maintaining test automation frameworks

Research and analysis of Test automation tools conducting POCs using opensource tools and preparing implementation plan Intermediate experience testing REST web services in a service oriented architecture

Intermediate experience working with data interchange formats such as XML and JSON or GSON Intermediate experience with basic ideas concepts and practices of build tools and CI CD CD

Needs to be able to write good code in Java Python and exhibit a solid understanding of OOP concepts and principles Proven experience in Java Javascript or python playwright Selenium Jenkins GitHub AWS

Clear understanding in relational database or NoSQL database

Embracing Agile and lean principles

Solid written and verbal communication skills

Capable of multitasking and ability to play the role of Automation Architect for the project Deliver work to agreed estimates and timescales

Follow Agile techniques and be an active member of the Scrum Team

Media domain knowledge is a plus Experience in Copilot Git Hub Copilot is plus

Work Timings :Ready to work in 12:00 PM to 09:30 PM IST Shift timings

 **Skills**

**Mandatory Skills :** API/Microservices RestAssured Testing, BrowserStack for Testing, Mobility Testing (iOS, Android, Streaming)  
**Good to Have Skills :** Appium-Python -Testing, Selenium-Python -Testing
